name: The Basement
source:
Tetsuo wakes in a strange place with only Natasha for company – kind, attentive, and just a little too perfect. As their conversations grow deeper, so do his doubts, and the line between comfort and control begins to blur.

[From [url=https://lexiixyk.itch.io/the-basement-official]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
铁男在一个陌生的地方醒来，身边只有娜塔莎陪伴——她善良、细心，而且有点过于完美。随着他们的谈话越来越深入，他的疑虑也越来越深，舒适和控制之间的界限开始变得模糊。

[来自[url=https://lexiixyk.itch.io/the-basement-official]Itch.io[/url]]
